earlierLocatedOracle.failureExplanation: Three empty-entropy cases exposed a Darwin /dev/fd socket transport artifact: native fopen returned EACCES after the parent closed an empty socket, rather than observing regular-file EOF. Those cases now use native /dev/null and an explicitly empty VFS file at the same pathname; no product EACCES workaround was added.
